notes.title: Disc Golf City – Full Release is Here!
notes.content:
[h3][b]It’s official – [i]Disc Golf City[/i] has left Early Access![/b][/h3][p]We’re thrilled to share that after months of testing, feedback, and community support, [i]Disc Golf City[/i] is now fully released!   [/p][p][b]What’s new in the Full Release:[/b]  [/p][p]• 🏙️ New courses and city locations to master  [/p][p]• 🎯 Improved disc physics and shot mechanics  [/p][p]• 🎮 Polished UI and smoother controls  [/p][p]• 🏆 Steam Achievements & leaderboards  [/p][p]
A [b]huge thank you[/b] to everyone who joined us during Early Access. Your feedback has been vital in shaping the game into what it is today.  [/p][p][b]
This is just the beginning![/b] [/p][p]We’ll continue supporting [i]Disc Golf City[/i] with updates, events, and new content down the road.  [/p][p]So grab your disc, hit the fairways of the city, and aim for glory.  [/p][p]See you on the streets! 🥏[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45634802/e51f3433de15ad956abdf0bb3ba172dd07f581f4.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: New Leaderboards Coming This Monday
notes.content:
[p]🏆 [b]Big news for our competitive players![/b][/p][p]This [b]Monday, 8th September 2025[/b], we’ll be introducing [b]all-new Leaderboards[/b] to match the new courses recently added to [i]Disc Golf City[/i].[/p][p]That means:[/p][list][*][p]✅ Brand new boards for each course.[/p][/*][*][p]🎯 A fresh chance to claim those top spots.[/p][/*][*][p]⚠️ All existing scores will be [b]wiped[/b] as part of the reset.[/p][/*][/list][p]We know some of you have set amazing scores already, but with the update to courses and mechanics, we want everyone to start on a level playing field.[/p][p]So if you’re gunning for the top of the leaderboard, get ready. The race starts again this Monday![/p][p][/p][p]The leaderboards are found here: [/p][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/stats/3753060/leaderboards/16980109/"]https://steamcommunity.com/stats/3753060/leaderboards/16980109/[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for playing and competing,
Agapo Games[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45634802/f235d7754d2118859f43704007a783d4d8d80fad.png"][/img][/p]

 (Thank you for your patience and reporting problems)

notes.title: Urban Disc Golf is now DISC GOLF CITY
notes.content:
👋 Hey players!

We’re excited to announce that Urban Disc Golf has officially been renamed to Disc Golf City!

This update is more than just a new name. it’s our biggest Early Access milestone so far:


🏙 A new city environment to explore and play in.
⛳ New courses designed to challenge both beginners and veterans.
💨 New throwing mechanics for more realistic and satisfying disc control.


We’re still in Early Access, and this update is a big step toward the full release. Your feedback has been incredibly helpful, and we’d love to hear what you think of the new city and mechanics.


👉 What’s Next?
More content, more polish, and continued improvements. Wishlist, review, and tell your friends. It helps us shape Disc Golf City into the best game it can be.


Thanks for being part of the journey,
– Agapo Games

notes.title: Playtest Ending Soon – Transition to Private Beta
notes.content:
[p]👋 [b]Dear players,[/b][/p][p]We want to give you a heads-up:[/p][p]In [b]one month’s time[/b], the [b]Disc Golf City Playtest[/b] will be [b]closing down[/b].[/p][p]The Playtest has been incredibly valuable — it’s helped us gather feedback, refine mechanics, and improve stability during development. However, we’ve reached the point where managing updates through Steam’s Playtest system has become difficult, and it’s served its purpose.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45634802/b939b89d55117bd763f6b99a525e636b6c77dc64.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]🔄 [b]What’s next?[/b]
We’ll be running our [b]“Next Version Beta”[/b] through a [b]private testing program[/b] instead. This gives us more flexibility to experiment with builds, gather targeted feedback, and move development forward more effectively.[/p][p]💡 [b]Want to be involved?[/b]
If you’d like to apply to join the private beta, and believe you can add value with constructive feedback then please reach out to us directly. We’d love to hear from you![/p][p]Thank you to everyone who took part in the Playtest. Your input has been a huge part of shaping [i]Disc Golf City[/i].[/p][p]Agapo Games[/p]
